mapper.sql: from hr_employee_health_certificate certificate left join sys_user applicant on applicant.user_id = certificate.user_id and applicant.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept anchor_dept on anchor_dept.dept_id = certificate.dept_id_snapshot

'LEGACY' engineMode, 'HR_HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' businessCode, certificate.certificate_id legacyInstanceId, cast(certificate.certificate_id as char) businessId, certificate.certificate_no businessNo, 1 businessRound, case certificate.review_status when 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 'RUNNING' else certificate.review_status end status, case when certificate.review_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 1 else null end currentNodeOrder, case when certificate.review_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' then '旧健康证人事审核' else null end currentNodeName, certificate.user_id applicantUserId, coalesce(nullif(trim(applicant.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(applicant.user_name), ''), certificate.create_by) applicantName, certificate.dept_id_snapshot anchorDeptId, anchor_dept.dept_name anchorDeptName, certificate.create_time startedTime, case when certificate.review_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' then null else coalesce(certificate.reviewed_time, certificate.update_time) end finishedTime
mapper.select:
select
order by certificate.create_time desc, certificate.certificate_id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select
where certificate.certificate_id = #{certificateId} and certificate.del_flag = '0' and certificate.approval_instance_id is null and certificate.review_status in ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') limit 1

select certificate.certificate_id taskId, 1 nodeOrder, '旧健康证人事审核' nodeName, '旧流程健康证审核负责人' candidateNames, case certificate.review_status when 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 'PENDING' else certificate.review_status end status, case certificate.review_status when 'APPROVED' then 'APPROVE' when 'REJECTED' then 'REJECT' else null end action, certificate.reviewed_by_user_id operatorUserId, certificate.reviewed_by_name operatorName, certificate.rejection_reason comment, certificate.reviewed_time actionTime from hr_employee_health_certificate certificate where certificate.certificate_id = #{certificateId} and certificate.del_flag = '0' and certificate.approval_instance_id is null and certificate.review_status in ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
